footer.disclaimer: Catalogue data, opening hours, fares and travel times are approximate samples for demonstration. Always check official sources before you travel.

home.title: Plan a smarter trip through Japan
home.subtitle: Choose places, dates and a budget. Tabiji builds a day-by-day schedule that respects opening hours, travel times and your must-sees — and explains every decision.
home.featureOptimizerTitle: A real optimizer, not a guess
home.featureOptimizerBody: Iterated local search over opening hours, travel times, budget and daily limits. Never worse than your own order.
home.featureHoursBody: Museums closed on Mondays open on national holidays and close the next day instead — using the official holiday calendar.
home.featureHonestBody: Travel times and fares are labelled as estimates. If there is no transit data, Tabiji says so instead of inventing it.
home.featureBilingualBody: Every screen, place name and explanation is available in Japanese and English.

auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A passphrase of a few random words is easy to remember and strong.

trips.title: My trips
trips.emptyBody: Create your first itinerary — pick a few places and let Tabiji plan the days.

editor.title: Title
editor.budgetHint: Covers estimated entrance fees and local transport. Hotels and meals are not included.
editor.suggestionsHint: Adds places that match your interests when there is time left. Your own places always come first.
editor.conflict: This trip was changed in another tab or device. Reload to see the latest version.

notices.ESTIMATED_TRAVEL: Travel times and fares are estimates (≈), not timetable data.
notices.SAMPLE_CATALOG_DATA: Opening hours and prices are sample data. Check official websites before you travel.
notices.HOLIDAY_DATA_UNAVAILABLE: No national-holiday data for these dates, so holiday opening rules were not applied.
notices.SEARCH_TIME_LIMIT_REACHED: The search stopped at its time limit. The plan is valid but may not be the best possible.

reasons.CLOSED_ON_TRIP_DATES: Closed on all of your dates
reasons.OUTSIDE_DAILY_HOURS: Not open long enough within your daily hours
reasons.NO_ROUTE: No route with the travel modes you allowed (no transit data nearby)
reasons.TOO_FAR_FOR_DAY: Too far to go there and back within a day
reasons.OVER_BUDGET: Costs more than your whole budget
reasons.CONFLICTS_WITH_MUST_VISITS: Does not fit together with your other must-visits
reasons.DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED: Every possible day already has the maximum number of places
reasons.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: Your budget is used up by higher-priority places
reasons.NOT_ENOUGH_TIME: Not enough time left after higher-priority places
reasons.DOES_NOT_FIT_GIVEN_ORDER: Would fit in a different order

hints.EXTEND_DAILY_HOURS: Start earlier or come back later each day.
hints.ALLOW_MORE_TRAVEL_MODES: Allow taxis (or walking) for places without transit data.
hints.ADD_DAYS: Add a day to your trip.
hints.USE_OPTIMIZER: Press Optimize to let Tabiji reorder the places.
